gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham has rounded, tall lowercase forms and generous entry space into every curve. Edo SZ answers with one constant stroke, a thread of ink at display size.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee stands tall, with short stalks above the letters. Edo SZ draws every stroke ending at the same measured thickness, while the body's e leaves a wide gap at its terminal, so text moves along without friction.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-chorasmia: Noto Sans Chorasmian has curves that stop short of closing. Edo SZ, drawn with the weight of a wire, looks best large, and the body's big x-height and short ascenders hold up at a modest size.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Contemporary in feel, Noto Sans Coptic lets its middle zone dominate each line. Edo SZ has crossbars as thick as its stems, so the text beneath reads openly, with uncrowded mouths on the s and c.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Edo SZ builds its letters from rods rather than carved blades, with a lowercase that has cast iron stature. Noto Sans Cuneiform sits beneath it, its e opening up and its lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Wide, high and friendly, Noto Sans Deseret pairs open apertures with squat ascenders, set under Edo SZ, whose strokes show no modulation. A longer text moves along easily.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-devanagar: Noto Sans Devanagari reads with a compact skyline, where capitals blend into lowercase and the g keeps an open lower curve. Edo SZ is best at showing off its stressless curves in big display lines; Noto Sans Devanagari does best at quiet running text.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Duployan gives the lowercase a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters in e and a. Edo SZ, with no tapering like a quill's pressure, sits above it with a steady, cultured hand.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan uses large lowercase forms with tight ascender clearance and open terminals that never pinch shut. Edo SZ earns its keep when big and short.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic keeps its apertures open throughout, with ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Edo SZ, drawn as if with a marker tip, looks best at a generous size, while the body is fine smaller.
